cases.input: Three bids arrive under criteria v1 and a material criterion change is published.
cases.expect: An addendum and criteria v2 create a successor round while the v1 round remains readable.

cases.input: An evaluator discloses an interest and is independently recused.
cases.expect: Affected results remain, exclusions are explicit and a replacement round is attributable.

cases.input: One supplier is considered under an authorized single-source ground.
cases.expect: A real one-alternative set, justification and waiver are recorded without simulated competition.

cases.input: A sealed bid is exposed before the witnessed opening event.
cases.expect: The disclosure is rejected.

cases.input: Criteria v1 outcomes are recomputed in place after criteria v2 publication.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected.

cases.input: Selecting a winning bid automatically creates a signed contract and order.
cases.expect: Both transitions are rejected.

cases.input: Round 1 is finalized under criteria v1 while round 2 is open under criteria v2 in the same sourcing event.
cases.expect: Both round states coexist and the event status is 'evaluating'; no event-level seal or opening state is asserted.

cases.input: The event is set to status 'sealed' while round 2 must be 'open', using the event lifecycle to represent round state.
cases.expect: Rejected: seal and opening states belong to SourcingRound, not SourcingEvent.

cases.input: A round transitions to 'opened' with no openedAt and no openingWitnessRef.
cases.expect: Rejected: a witnessed opening record with an explicit instant is mandatory for the 'opened' state.

cases.input: A bid is received at 2026-10-01T09:14:00+02:00, sealed on receipt, and opened at 2026-10-08T10:00:00+02:00 under a named witness.
cases.expect: Receipt, seal and opening instants are stored separately and all three remain resolvable.

cases.input: A BidEvaluation outcome is recorded for a bid whose receipt sealState is still 'sealed'.
cases.expect: Rejected: sealed content is unreadable for evaluation until a witnessed opening is recorded against that round.

cases.input: A sealed bid receipt is recorded with no per-bid contentDigest, relying on the round-level digest instead.
cases.expect: Rejected: each sealed submission carries its own content digest; a round digest cannot evidence per-bid integrity.

cases.input: A bid arrives after submissionWindow.closesAt and is admitted under a recorded waiver.
cases.expect: Admissibility is 'late-admitted' with a waiving role, rule waived and reason retained; the original receipt instant is unchanged.

cases.input: The buyer assigns its own bid identifier on receipt and stores it as the bid's identity.
cases.expect: Rejected: bid identity is supplier-issued; the buyer may hold only a receipt binding to bidRef and bidVersion.

cases.input: submissionWindow.closesAt is recorded as '2026-10-08 17:00' with no seconds and no UTC offset.
cases.expect: Rejected: every instant is RFC 3339 with seconds and an explicit offset.

cases.input: A criteria set version is published with a version label but no criteriaEffectiveFrom.
cases.expect: Rejected: every criteria release carries a version and an effective time that outcomes can pin.

cases.input: A recusal triggers a round with roundKind 'remediation' that pins criteria v2 and the identical bid versions, with no new submission window.
cases.expect: Accepted: the remediation round is attributable, binds the same criteria version, and reopens no submissions.

cases.input: A material criterion change issues an addendum notified at one instant to every participant in the round's participant scope.
cases.expect: Accepted: notifiedParticipantRefs equals the round participant scope; criteria v2 and a successor round are created.

cases.input: An addendum changing a criterion is notified only to the two participants the buyer deems affected, out of five in scope.
cases.expect: Rejected: post-publication changes are notified to all participants in the round's participant scope.

cases.input: procedureKind is recorded as the free-text value 'expedited sourcing exercise'.
cases.expect: Rejected: procedureKind is one of open, restricted, negotiated, single-source.

cases.input: procedureKind is 'single-source' with a one-alternative set but no justificationGround and no decidingAuthorityRef.
cases.expect: Rejected: single-source requires a justification ground, a competent deciding authority and a mandate scope.

cases.input: A single-source event records one real alternative, a justification ground, deciding authority and mandate scope, and no waiver.
cases.expect: Accepted: the waiver is optional; no dummy bid or simulated competitive round is created.

cases.input: The event status is set to 'awarded' with no awardDecisionRef.
cases.expect: Rejected: the 'awarded' state requires a referential award decision link and asserts no agreement or order.

cases.input: A sourcing event is published with neither an authorizingRequestRef nor a declared noRequestGround.
cases.expect: Rejected: an event cites exactly one authorizing request or an explicit enumerated ground for having none.

cases.input: A request in status 'rejected' is used as the authorizingRequestRef of a published event.
cases.expect: Rejected: a rejected or withdrawn request cannot authorize a sourcing event.

cases.input: An invariant set of twelve entries is submitted with fixtures covering nine of them under requiresInvariantCoverage.
cases.expect: Rejected: every invariant maps to at least one fixture.
